create_fmm_planner: create an FMMPlanner instance with a traversible binary map and optional scale and step size
set_goal_single: set a single goal on the FMMPlanner to compute fast marching method distance transform
set_goal_multi: set multiple goals via a goal map to compute multi-target FMM distance transform
get_short_term_goal: get the next short-term goal coordinates and replan flag from the current robot state
generate_circular_mask: generate a circular annulus mask for the planner's local neighborhood search window
